shortDescription: A local Windows workspace for files, scripts, screenshots and pinned ideas.
description:
Bring your everyday tools into one native Windows workspace. Convert supported images, work with PDF pages, read scripts in a floating teleprompter, capture and annotate screenshots, record and edit silent MP4 clips, organize temporary clipboard snippets, and keep useful content in Brainiac Edge.

Open tools inside the main window. Use Command Center to find actions, Workspaces to save tool collections, and manual Workflows for repeatable file operations. Core processing works locally without a required account.
features: Native Windows interface with light and dark themes
Image conversion, PDF assembly and page operations
Script library and configurable floating teleprompter
Screenshot annotations and offline OCR with installed Windows language support
Screen recording and basic silent MP4 editing
Brainiac Edge pinboard with tags, favourites, search and local backup
Clipboard Shelf with explicit monitoring consent and optional protected persistence
File hashes, reviewed renames, ZIP archives and duplicate scanning
Manual workflows and saved tool workspaces
releaseNotes: Initial Store candidate. Includes integrated tool pages, floating reading and pinboard workspaces, offline file utilities, local privacy controls and light/dark themes. Release remains subject to package certification.
systemRequirements: Windows 11 (build 22000 or later), x64. Offline OCR and voice-follow availability depend on installed Windows language components. Microphone permission is needed only for optional voice follow.
submissionStatus: Assigned identity configured. Certification and installed-package lifecycle acceptance pending.
